label: Published method: 2025 data with the thesis method
description: The 2025 data with the method of the thesis, unchanged and its errors kept (line 1 of the two lines of enquiry): the tip of the data chain, identical to 2025-fuel. Compare with 2011-corrected for a like-for-like change since 2011, with 2025-fixed for the effect of correcting errors and with 2025-improved for the effect of the improved method on the same data.
